title: 3.2.15 Lab: Fix a Function That Prints Instead of Returning
description: A function computes correctly but prints its result, so the caller gets undefined. Fix it to return, and prove the fix with arithmetic. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run it and read the symptom
steps.instructions: Run the starter. The function prints the area, but the variable that stores the call prints as undefined. That is the tell of a missing return.

steps.title: Find the missing return
steps.instructions: Look at where the function hands its answer to console.log. The function ends without a return, so the call produces undefined.

steps.title: Fix the function
steps.instructions: Change the function so it returns the computed value instead of printing it. Use return, and let the caller print the result.

steps.title: Prove the fix
steps.instructions: Use the returned value in an expression, such as doubling it, and log the result. If the arithmetic works, a real number came back.

requirements.title: area defined
requirements.description: Code defines a function named area

requirements.title: result used in an expression
requirements.description: Code multiplies the function result, proving a number came back
